answer_1.quote: In this paper, we aim to automatically generate faithful texts from tables... Table-to-text generation helps making knowledge elements and their connections in tables easier to comprehend by human.
answer_1.outputs: Paragraph-level natural language descriptions faithful to the input table

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we apply the widely used evaluation metrics including the standard BLEU-4, METEOR and ROUGE scores... we also apply the PARENT metric... we further modify the PARENT metric to measure... we denote this new metric as PARENT-T.

answer_4.quote: We conduct extensive human evaluation on the generated descriptions... 20 well-trained raters participating in the evaluation... we ask the human raters to evaluate the grammar, fluency, and faithfulness.
answer_4.guideline: The raters are trained with word instructions and text examples of the grading standard beforehand; during evaluation they assess grammar, fluency, and faithfulness of each generated sentence.
